definitions.gloss: embezzlement; misappropriation; pocketing money or goods
definitions.explanation: The act of secretly taking money or property that has been entrusted to one's care. Implies a betrayal of trust in a professional or organizational context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着服|ちゃくふく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{経理|けいり}→経理：06439_keiri⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{売上金|うりあげきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着服|ちゃくふく}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The accountant had been pocketing the sales revenue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって⟦{公金|こうきん}→公金：29287_koukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着服|ちゃくふく}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}→発覚：07629_hakkaku⟧し、⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was discovered that public funds had been embezzled over many years, and the person was arrested.

notes:
Originally meant "putting on clothes" (⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ + ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧), but the modern primary meaning is embezzlement — secretly putting money "into one's own pocket." The clothing sense is now rare.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着服|ちゃくふく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pocket money
- ⟦{公金|こうきん}→公金：29287_koukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着服|ちゃくふく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to embezzle public funds
- {売上金|うりあげきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{着服|ちゃくふく}: embezzlement of sales proceeds
- {着服|ちゃくふく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}する→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧: embezzlement is discovered

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{横領|おうりょう}→横領：09001_ouryou⟧: embezzlement — more formal legal term, used in criminal law
- {着服|ちゃくふく}: pocketing — slightly more colloquial, emphasizes the sneaky nature
- {使|つか}い{込|こ}み: misuse of funds — spending entrusted money on personal expenses
- ⟦{流用|りゅうよう}→流用：13393_ryuuyou⟧: diversion of funds — redirecting money to an unauthorized purpose
